name: nea-backend
description: Nea (SIH 2026, PSID 198, team Fremen) — backend workspace. node-api (Node.js/Express+Prisma) owns everything: auth, database, chat/Groq, TTS/STT, and memory consolidation. ai-service (Python) is now ONLY the ML risk classifier — see backend/CLAUDE.md. `npm start` at this level runs both together.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:node && npm run install:python
scripts.start: concurrently -n node,risk -c blue,green "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:risk"
